images.title: One more column adds 23
images.purpose: Shows 23 × 28 as a 23 by 27 block plus one thin column of 23, so the product grows by 23.
images.composition: One large rectangle block centred with a thin strip along its right edge. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large teal (#0072B2) filled rectangle drawn as a solid block (no dots), 27 units wide and 23 units tall, with the label '27' centred above it, the label '23' centred to its left and the label '23 × 27' centred inside it. Along its right edge, a thin amber (#E69F00) strip 1 unit wide and 23 units tall, with the label '1' above it and the label '23 × 1' just to its right. Centred below the whole figure, the label 'a(b + c) = ab + ac'. Exactly 1 block and 1 strip.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Increasing 27 by 1 adds one 23, because a(b + c) = ab + ac.
images.description: Shows 23 × 28 as a 23 by 27 block plus one thin column of 23, so the product grows by 23.

image_decisions.why: The thin column makes visible why the added amount is the other number, 23, and not 1.
